description: This 1.2 km trail, via the Pom Pom trail, follows along a bench above Pine Creek and ends at Pine Creek Falls. The trail gives views overlooking the valley and if you look carefully you can see the old Atlin powerhouse in the trees, on the valley bottom.
directions: The Crocus and Pom Pom trails both start at the new Atlin Cemetery, approximately 5 kms west of Altin on the Surprise Creek Road. Park at the cemetery.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - North Coast - Kalum - Cassiar

title: Crocus Trail
